name: The Peckening

phases.note: AYCE runs tomato/onion/tomato/onion/tomato; OC1 swaps the second tomato for mushroom, and drops the last two orders in single player

legendExtensions.Y: deep fryer with a frying basket
the street between the two buildings: void the chefs cannot cross on foot

crates.note: every crate rides the ferry platform and the set changes per phase: mushroom/tomato/onion in phase 1; bun and chop-needing crates in phase 2; pizza and fish-and-chips crates in phase 3; a full set in phase 4

dynamics.detail: a platform slung under Kevin's helicopter crosses between the two buildings, carrying every crate; its layout is rebuilt each phase (sideways H of counters, then two conveyor sections that move up and down, then a board-split slab that rotates 90 degrees clockwise, then three tables that crawl across with stops in the middle and at each edge)
meteors fall throughout and set counters alight on impact; one strike is scripted at the start of phase 2, hitting the right building's oven, chopping board and nearby counters
four phases of five orders; each ends when its last order reaches the Ever Peckish. Cookware must be swapped by hand between phases: pots to pans before phase 2, at least one pot back before phase 4

hazards: falling meteors set counters on fire
the street between the buildings cannot be crossed on foot
missingMechanics: scripted order phases that end on delivery
a ferry platform rebuilt per phase, with rotation and multi-stop travel
meteors that set counters alight, plus a scripted strike
deep fryer and the fish-and-chips family
cookware taken off a burner and swapped pot to pan
estimates: the OC1 phase-1 order list (the wiki gives the AYCE order plus a trivia note on the OC1 differences)
